component.name: Hangar
component.summary: A native Bluesky client for Linux

description.p: Hangar is a desktop Bluesky client designed specifically for Linux and the GNOME desktop environment. No Electron, no web views, no hybrid UI, just native GTK4 with Libadwaita for a fast, integrated experience.
This is a technical preview. The app is functional but incomplete. Development follows a slice-by-slice methodology, one feature at a time.
What a full audit turned up.

ul.li: Fixed a hang that could freeze the whole window until the app was killed
Fixed two ways memory could run away, one of them without any user action
Direct messages, notifications, activity and people lists are reachable by keyboard and screen reader
Sign out revokes the session and removes the stored credential
New posts no longer rebuild the feed while you are reading it
Window size and position persist, which no packaged build managed before
Faster feed refreshes, non-blocking link opening, and the screen stays awake during video

description.p: KDE fixes and a memory hunt.

ul.li: Icons render on KDE, and the app icon no longer sits on a black plate
Video stops decoding the moment it scrolls off screen, and frames stay on the GPU
Nightly downloads carry names of their own

description.p: Video uploads, real conversations, and the social layer.

ul.li: Video and GIF upload with live progress, alt text, and a Post button that waits for processing
Video plays inline in the feed and in a dedicated player, with autoplay and volume preferences
Chat conversations: open a thread, send messages, and react with emoji
Follow and unfollow anywhere, follower lists, and people search
Full profile pages with Posts, Replies, Media, and Videos tabs, plus in-app profile editing
Moderation: mute, block, and report accounts and posts
Keyboard shortcuts throughout, offline handling, empty states, and loading skeletons

description.p: Manual Flatpak builds stamp their version too.
Flatpak release builds stamp their version.
Release builds report their real version in the About dialog.
OAuth authentication, direct messages, and quality improvements.

ul.li: OAuth authentication (PKCE + DPoP) with persistent sessions
Direct messages: conversation list with unread badges and message preview
Quote post navigation opens threads in-app instead of the browser
Chat empty state for accounts with no messages
Flatpak runtime updated to GNOME 48
Fixed GTK CSS parser warnings
Rich compose dialog with image attachments, threaded posting, link card previews, content warnings, language picker, and interaction settings
Color scheme settings (system, light, dark)
Extended text size range
AppImage delta updates
Fixed emoji horizontal overshoot in post rendering
